# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This project uses a centralized agent instruction document.

## Entry Point

Refer to `.agent/AGENT_INSTRUCTION.md` for complete project context.

The document includes:
- Functional requirements and system metrics to collect
- Architecture diagrams and data flow
- Technical stack (Shell + jq + curl, no external dependencies)
- Coding standards for Shell, PHP, JavaScript, and CSS
- Directory structure with deployment path mappings
- Test cases and acceptance criteria
- Development guidelines: investigate first, minimal changes, no unnecessary optimizations, verify after every change
